title: MCT provenance credential prototype for AI-ready MOF data
description: Synthetic, non-financial prototype package accompanying Paper 1. This metadata-cleanup release preserves the same prototype logic while using low-risk MCT provenance-credential wording. It demonstrates contribution-schema design, non-financial reputation-score simulation, metadata-style verification, and a non-transferable credential stub. It is not a deployed blockchain, financial token system, cryptocurrency, investment product, or production governance platform.
